criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1 and 7 strong, 6's idea strong. 5 a mannequin head under the kicker, a detached pink hand, a warm brown field with no ground (canvas mean 56.3). 4 a mid grey desk top filling the bottom 40 percent and a bright strip past the desk's edge, a product shot. 8 collar clips and a blank brown rectangle, no window. 3 far lids alias and are uniformly bright. Lawn reads as rippled water; pavers as plywood; oak foliage under 9's hook.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero and the inlay motif through the deck, both devices work. 4 and 5 leave the world; value track 39, 19, 27, 76, 56, 27, 29, 33, 22 strobes from 3 to 6; room 8 has no window tying it to the west key.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the count was checked. First comment omits c16; 'two committees' leans on the claim text's reading.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, when and what a reader can do are all there; who decides is honestly unnamed; the stake for 79,000 students stays general.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Real turns at 4 and 7; flat cover; 5 could move; 8 restates 6's date.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and local; procedural disclosure lines; generic cover headline.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The hero and opening move repeat no. 38 (2026-09-30): the student_desk with its laptop alone on a field, then counted as instanced desks, leader labels on the desk, a person at the close. Also no. 46's lastLight world and one unit per day, and no. 37's granite hex.

one_sentence_fix: Check every pitched hero and opening move against the last 14 artwork.json entries before the storyboard locks; this deck's hero and cover are no. 38's.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin head under the kicker and hook, a detached pink hand, a flat warm brown field, a mid tone frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Over the right shoulder with the head out of frame, both hands in the lid's light, the lawn and near black sky behind the lid.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid grey desk top fills the bottom 40 percent, a bright strip past the desk's edge, a plum gradient behind the lid, a product shot.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera and tilt up so the lawn and seam show over the lid, crop the desk top into shadow, the sheet ends on the desk, the page toward L* 70.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Collar clips on the figures, a blank brown rectangle as the biggest lit area, no window.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A sill height window of last light on the left as the one source; remove the collar mesh or recrop to shoulders in shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Far lids alias, uniformly bright, the block a busy grey grid.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut the instanced lids to the planned low level and mip the far rows so only the hero lid reads bright.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Walker's hair a pale block, oak foliage under the hook.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push the oak into a silhouette, a dark hair or cap material on the walker.
